{{Quote|Behold the patron of glory! Eyes afire with righteous might; skin bathed in the warm blood of the enemy&mdash;witness the glory and blazing fury!<br />His wrath rains down like fire from above. Bodies encircle him like a pyre. A [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''husband''' of the Voss [[Tala-Reh]] and a member of his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Voss commandos|commandos]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. On the Voss' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Voss|same name]], Tala-Reh's [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] was sent by the [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Valen-Da]] on a suicide mission to confront [[Jokull]], the [[King/Legends|king]] of the hostile [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Knowing that he would meet his own [[Death/Legends|death]] in the process, the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] challenged Jokull to a duel, and the Voss defeated twenty of the hundred Gormak warriors sent to kill him before he himself fell in battle. The commando's death greatly inspired the Voss people, and many celebratory songs and poems were written in his honor.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Valen-Da had a vision. He sent my husband to Gorma-Koss. Alone. There he met his fate. He challenged the Gormak king to a duel. The king refused. A hundred Gormak warriors fell on him. Twenty died before he fell. The king sent my husband's head back to Voss-Ka. Just as Valen-Da foresaw.|Tala-Reh|<ref name="Vault" />}}
[[File:Tala-Reh.png|thumb|right|200px|Tala-Reh]]
A [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] joined the [[Voss commandos]], the military organization of his [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Voss]], sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He also [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a woman named [[Tala-Reh]].<ref name="Vault" /> At some point before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Valen-Da]] experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of Tala-Reh's husband and met with the man to explain the prophecy. In Valen-Da's vision, the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] would be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Jokull]], the [[King/Legends|king]] of the hostile [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with which the Voss shared their homeworld, and Jokull would send the fallen warrior's head back to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]].<ref name="Vault" />

Despite the knowledge that he would die in the process, the commando followed Valen-Da's instructions and traveled to the Gormak city of [[Gorma-Koss]] alone, where he came before Jokull and challenged him to a [[Duel (short story)|duel]]. Jokull refused and ordered a hundred of his Gormak warriors to attack the Voss, but the commando fought back and slew twenty of his attackers before he himself was killed. Just as in Valen-Da's vision, Jokull cut off the man's head and sent it back to Voss-Ka. The commando's sacrifice greatly inspired the Voss people, and many joined the ranks of the commandos&mdash;including his wife, Tala-Reh, who became a commando and served Valen-Da as his protector. Many songs and poems were written in the man's honor,<ref name="Vault" /> and in 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Tala-Reh recited [[Poem about Tala-Reh's husband|one such poem]] to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] prowess in [[Attack on Fulminiss's base|battle]] reminded her of her husband.<ref name="Vault" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You remind me of him. Strong. Fierce. An instrument of Mystic will.|Tala-Reh, to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Vault" />}}
A steadfastly loyal commando, Tala-Reh's husband was more than willing to lay down his life in the service of the Mystics. Even though he knew he would die in the process, the commando carried out Valen-Da's instructions and challenged Jokull to a duel. Tala-Reh remembered her husband as a strong and fierce warrior, and his sacrifice inspired her to join the commandos herself.<ref name="Vault" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tala-Reh's husband was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], during the Jedi Knight class mission "Vault of the Gormak King" on Voss.<ref name="Vault" />
